requirements.statement: Each additional content that appears on focus or hover of an interface component stays visible until one of the accepted ends.

citations.quote: Chaque contenu additionnel qui apparaît à la prise de focus ou au survol d’un composant d’interface vérifie-t-il une de ces conditions (hors cas particuliers) ?

routes.statement: It stays visible until the user moves the pointer or the focus away from both the additional content and the component that triggered it.

citations.quote: Le contenu additionnel reste visible jusqu’à ce que l’utilisateur retire le pointeur souris ou le focus du contenu additionnel et du composant d’interface ayant déclenché son apparition ;

routes.statement: It stays visible until the user triggers an action that hides it without moving the focus or the pointer from the triggering component.

citations.quote: Le contenu additionnel reste visible jusqu’à ce que l’utilisateur déclenche une action masquant ce contenu sans déplacer le focus ou le pointeur de la souris du composant d’interface ayant déclenché son apparition ;

routes.statement: It stays visible until its information is no longer valid, such as a busy indicator or an error message shown until the input is corrected.

citations.quote: Le contenu additionnel reste visible jusqu’à ce qu’il ne soit plus valide.

Jusqu’à ce que l’information proposée par le contenu additionnel ne soit plus valide (par exemple un contenu additionnel signalant l’état “occupé” du composant d’interface que l’utilisateur souhaite activer ou encore un message d’erreur signalé sous la forme d’un contenu additionnel tant que l’utilisateur n’a pas rectifié sa saisie).

exceptions.statement: Additional content controlled by the user agent, such as the tooltip of a title attribute or a native form-validation message.

citations.quote: Lorsque le contenu additionnel est contrôlé par l’agent utilisateur (par exemple, attribut `title` ou validation native de formulaire)

exceptions.statement: Additional content that becomes visible when the user activates something, such as a dialog window.

citations.quote: Des contenus additionnels devenant visibles par une activation de l’utilisateur (par exemple, une fenêtre de dialogue).

exceptions.statement: Additional content that is a modal window conforming to the WAI-ARIA dialog design pattern; the criterion is then not applicable.

citations.quote: ou correspond à une fenêtre modale conforme au motif de conception WAI-ARIA `dialog`, le critère 10.13 est non applicable.

rationale.text: The test asks that content appearing on focus or hover stays visible until one of three ends: the user moves the pointer or focus away from both the content and its trigger, the user triggers an action that hides it without moving away, or its information is no longer valid. These are alternatives, introduced by 'une de ces conditions'. The exceptions of criterion 10.13 apply: content controlled by the user agent, content shown on an activation, a conforming modal dialog. A check could see a content disappear while the pointer or focus stays on its trigger and nothing was pressed, which rules out the first two routes. It could not rule out the third: whether the information has stopped being valid, such as a busy indicator whose operation ended or an error message whose input was corrected, depends on what the content means. No mechanical rule separates a tooltip that vanishes on a timer from a status that has become obsolete. So no link could fault the requirement, no check is linked, and the candidate is none. A content that disappears when the pointer is moved onto it is faulted under test 10.13.2, on that test's own wording; here, that move also leaves the third route open. No axe rule is tagged for this test. Applicability is judgment: whether any content appears on focus or hover is only known by interacting with the page. Needs is keyboard and state: the content appears on keyboard focus or on hover.

citations.quote: Le contenu additionnel reste visible jusqu’à ce qu’il ne soit plus valide.
